name: squook
description: Prompt-to-video pipeline: CrewAI flow -> Remotion renderer -> Express API -> React webapp.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix webapp install && npm --prefix renderer install && cd guide_creator_flow && uv sync
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix webapp run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix webapp run dev"
